Form Component with React Hook Form

```tsx 'use client';

import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form'; import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod'; import { z } from 'zod';

type FormData = z.infer;

export function LoginForm({ onSubmit }: { onSubmit: (data: FormData) => void }) { const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { errors, isSubmitting }, } = useForm({ resolver: zodResolver(schema), });

Accessibility Checklist

  • [ ] Use semantic HTML elements
  • [ ] Add aria-label for icon-only buttons
  • [ ] Include role attributes where needed
  • [ ] Ensure keyboard navigation works
  • [ ] Add aria-invalid and aria-describedby for form errors
  • [ ] Use aria-busy for loading states
